name: SuperEarn
description: SuperEarn is a decentralized yield-earning DeFi protocol that allows users to deposit supported crypto assets and earn returns by allocating those assets into on-chain earning strategies.
methodology: TVL is the sum of totalAssets() across SuperEarn Super Vaults on Kaia. Each Super Vault holds a CooldownVault share (seCDV) as its underlying. EarnUSDT is reported in seCDV directly; EarnJPYC is reported in JPYC, converted from seCDV-JPYC through the CooldownVault own convertToAssets() because seCDV-JPYC has no price feed.
